summary: Replace invalid zero wall thresholds with Foundry V13's nullable no-threshold values so Scene creation passes server validation.

operations.before: threshold: { light: 0, sight: 0, sound: 0, attenuation: false },
operations.after: threshold: { light: null, sight: null, sound: null, attenuation: false },

checks.name: Wall thresholds are Foundry V13 nullable values
checks.run: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('scripts/orphaned-sun-scenes.mjs','utf8'); if(!s.includes('threshold: { light: null, sight: null, sound: null, attenuation: false }')) throw new Error('nullable thresholds missing'); if(s.includes('threshold: { light: 0, sight: 0, sound: 0')) throw new Error('zero thresholds remain');"
